##### Project general facts

Safa One de Grisogono is an iconic twin-tower residential development by Damac Properties, strategically located with panoramic views of Safa Park and the Dubai Canal. The project stands out for its distinctive architecture and design concept created in collaboration with the luxury jewelry brand de Grisogono, drawing inspiration from the brilliance and elegance of precious gemstones. The development introduces a new level of luxury living through its innovative design, premium residential spaces, and a unique rooftop ecosystem that creates a landmark presence within Dubai’s skyline.

The development offers an exceptional collection of amenities designed to provide an exclusive resort-style lifestyle. One of its most remarkable features is the state-of-the-art climate-control system capable of creating tropical rain at selected times of the day, delivering a truly unique sensory experience. Residents also benefit from an elevated rooftop ecosystem, beautifully landscaped leisure areas, swimming pools, and comprehensive security with round-the-clock video surveillance, creating a safe, comfortable, and highly luxurious living environment.

The interiors are fully furnished and ready for immediate occupancy, reflecting the project's sophisticated design philosophy. High-quality materials are used throughout the residences, with a light color palette serving as the foundation of the interior design. Luxurious natural stone flooring enhances the sense of space and reflects abundant natural light from the panoramic windows. The apartments feature fully equipped kitchens with appliances, while the overall finishing combines elegance, functionality, and premium craftsmanship inspired by the beauty and brilliance of precious stones.

##### Location description and benefits

Located in the heart of Dubai, Safa Park is one of the city’s most established and prestigious residential areas, known for its lush greenery, peaceful atmosphere, and central location. Surrounded by iconic districts such as Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, and Jumeirah, the area offers a rare balance between urban convenience and natural surroundings. Residents enjoy direct access to major highways, making travel across the city seamless and efficient.

The neighborhood is especially recognized for its scenic views of the Dubai Water Canal and close proximity to some of Dubai’s most famous landmarks, including Burj Khalifa and Burj Al Arab. The area combines luxury living with a calm residential atmosphere, enhanced by landscaped parks, waterfront promenades, cycling tracks, and leisure spaces. It has become a highly desirable address for those seeking premium lifestyle experiences within minutes of the city center.

Safa Park also offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s lifestyle and entertainment destinations. Residents are close to fine dining restaurants, luxury retail boutiques, beach clubs, international schools, and wellness centers, while still enjoying the privacy and tranquility of a greener environment. The combination of prime location, panoramic skyline views, and access to nature makes Safa Park one of Dubai’s most attractive and high-demand residential areas for both end-users and investors.
